Deriving data-driven HbA1c strata

BIOS PROJECT #1589 · METHODS PRESENTATION

Deriving data-driven HbA1c strata

Stratum-specific likelihood ratios
for 90-day complications after primary TSA

Jian He

Department of Biostatistics · School of Public Health
Virginia Commonwealth University

01 / 11

Study Background, Aim, and Data

One primary goal to identify TSA-specific HbA1c strata

  • Diabetes associated with complications after joint arthroplasty
  • Diabetes and outcomes following total shoulder arthroplasty (TSA) pooly defined
  • Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) a biomarker for diabetes
  • Pre-operative HbA1c thresholds from one clinical population not transportable
  • 20,757 patient records from TriNetX
    • Adults underwent primary TSA Jan. 1, 2016–Jan. 1, 2026
    • Pre-operative HbA1c recorded within 90 days

Address that primary goal using stratum-specific likelihood ratios (SSLRs)

02 / 11

Fundamentals

  • \(\mathrm{Likelihood}(H|\mathrm{data}) = K\cdot\mathrm{Pr}(\mathrm{data}|H)\)
  • H a hypothesis and K an arbitrary constant
  • Likelihoods NOT obey the laws of probability
  • Likelihood ratio for \(H_0\) vs. \(H_1 | \mathrm{data}\) \[= \frac{K\cdot\mathrm{Pr}(\mathrm{data}|H_0)}{K\cdot\mathrm{Pr}(\mathrm{data}|H_1)}\]
  • A dichotomous test (\(T+\) and \(T-\)) and binary disease states (\(D+\) and \(D-\)) \[LR+ = \frac{\mathrm{Pr}(T+|D+)}{\mathrm{Pr}(T+|D-)} \quad \quad LR- = \frac{\mathrm{Pr}(T-|D+)}{\mathrm{Pr}(T-|D-)}\]

Notation

Symbol Definition
\(X\) Pre-operative HbA1c (%)
\(Y\) Infection by 90 days: 1=yes; 0=no
\(S_g\) HbA1c interval; \(g=1,\ldots,G\)
\(G\) Number of intervals
\(n_1,n_0\) Total event / non-event counts
\(a_g,b_g\) Event / non-event counts in \(S_g\)
Symbol Definition
\(q_{1g}\) \(P(X\in S_g\mid Y=1)\)
\(q_{0g}\) \(P(X\in S_g\mid Y=0)\)
\(LR_g\) Stratum likelihood ratio: \(q_{1g}/q_{0g}\)
\(\pi\) Overall outcome risk: \(P(Y=1)\)
\(p_g\) Stratum risk: \(P(Y=1\mid X\in S_g)\)
\(\widehat{LR}_g\) estimated SSLR for stratum \(g\)

TPR = true-positive rate; FPR = false-positive rate; \(\Delta\) = change.

04 / 11

SSLR Computation and Interpretation

\[ LR_g = \frac{P(X\in S_g\mid Y=1)} {P(X\in S_g\mid Y=0)} \]

Estimation from observed counts

\[\widehat{LR}_g = \frac{a_g/n_1}{b_g/n_0}\]

Bayesian revision of odds

\[ \frac{\mathrm{Pr}(Y=1|X \in S_g)}{\mathrm{Pr}(Y=0|X \in S_g)} = \frac{\mathrm{Pr}(X \in S_g|Y=1)}{\mathrm{Pr}(X \in S_g|Y=0)} \times \frac{\mathrm{pr}(Y=1)}{\mathrm{pr}(Y=0)} \]

\(>1\): being in \(g\) increases odds of infection relative to the overall pretest odds

Notation

Symbol Definition
\(X\) Pre-op HbA1c
\(Y\) Infection (0/1)
\(S_g\) HbA1c interval
\(n_1,n_0\) Total cases/noncases
\(a_g,b_g\) Cases/noncases in \(S_g\)
\(\pi\) Overall risk
\(p_g\) Risk within \(S_g\)
\(LR_g\) Stratum likelihood ratio

05 / 11

SSLR as Slopes of ROC Curve Segments

Single cutoff: one point on the ROC curve defines two straight-line slopes

Generalization to \(g\) stratum

\[ \Delta \mathrm{TPR}_g=\frac{a_g}{n_1}, \quad \Delta \mathrm{FPR}_g=\frac{b_g}{n_0}, \quad \text{Segment slope}_g = \frac{\Delta \mathrm{TPR}_g}{\Delta \mathrm{FPR}_g} = \widehat{LR}_g \]

Notation & Abbreviations

Symbol Definition
TPR true-positive rate
FPR false-positive rate
\(a_g,b_g\) event / non-event counts in stratum \(g\)
\(n_1,n_0\) total event / non-event counts
\(\Delta\) change contributed by one stratum
\(\widehat{LR}_g\) estimated SSLR for stratum \(g\)

HbA1c \(\uparrow\), SSLR \(\uparrow\)

Variance Via Delta Method and 95% CI for SSLR

Notation

\(q_{1g},q_{0g}\): stratum proportions among cases/noncases

\(\widehat q_{1g},\widehat q_{0g}\): estimated proportions

\(a_g,b_g\): interval cases/noncases

\(n_1,n_0\): total cases/noncases

\(\widehat{LR}_g\): estimated SSLR

\[ \begin{gathered} a_g\sim\mathrm{Binomial}(n_1,q_{1g}),\quad b_g\sim\mathrm{Binomial}(n_0,q_{0g}),\\ \widehat q_{1g}=\frac{a_g}{n_1},\quad \widehat q_{0g}=\frac{b_g}{n_0},\quad \mathrm{Var}(\widehat q_{1g})=\frac{q_{1g}(1-q_{1g})}{n_1} \end{gathered} \]

\[ \log\widehat q_{1g} \approx \log q_{1g} +\frac{1}{q_{1g}}(\widehat q_{1g}-q_{1g}) \]

\[ \mathrm{Var}(\log\widehat q_{1g}) \approx \frac{1}{q_{1g}^{2}} \frac{q_{1g}(1-q_{1g})}{n_1},\quad \widehat{\mathrm{Var}}(\log\widehat q_{1g}) \approx \frac{1}{a_g}-\frac{1}{n_1},\quad \widehat{\mathrm{Var}}(\log\widehat q_{0g}) \approx \frac{1}{b_g}-\frac{1}{n_0} \]

\[ \log\widehat{LR}_g =\log\left(\frac{a_g}{n_1}\right) -\log\left(\frac{b_g}{n_0}\right), \quad \widehat{\mathrm{Var}}(\log\widehat{LR}_g) =\frac{1}{a_g}-\frac{1}{n_1} +\frac{1}{b_g}-\frac{1}{n_0} \]

\[ \boxed{ \mathrm{CI}_{95\%}(LR_g)= \exp\left[ \log\widehat{LR}_g \pm1.96\sqrt{ \widehat{\mathrm{Var}}(\log\widehat{LR}_g) } \right] } \]
